host: node scripts/wasix-lib-cert.mjs wasix-openssl --tarball <package.tgz>: links test/sslprobe.c against lib/ (static-main) and lib-pic/ (dynamic-main) with the pinned wasixcc and runs cert/*.mjs on the kernel's Node entry. A dev package has no commands of its own.
checklist: reproducible: OpenSSL_version(OPENSSL_BUILT_ON) is the pinned SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH (the 3.5.9 release, Tue Sep 29 14:10:08 2026 UTC); build.sh also refuses a libcrypto.a without it
both flavours compile with only pkg-config openssl (that flavour's .pc, the shipped opensslconf.h/configuration.h) and link with -Wl,--fatal-warnings, then run; OpenSSL_version is 3.5.9
long/size_t/off_t-sensitive calls: BIO_seek/BIO_tell on a file BIO, BIO_get_mem_data (long), BIO_ctrl_pending (size_t), BIO_ctrl with a long argument
AES-256-GCM: GCM spec test case 16 encrypt (ciphertext + tag), and a flipped tag fails decrypt
ECDSA P-256 and RSA-2048 (PKCS#1 v1.5, SHA-256) verify of fixed signatures made by Node's crypto; a tampered message fails both
RAND_bytes twice: success, non-zero, different (WASI random_get)
TLS 1.3 over a memory BIO pair: in-process self-signed P-256 certificate, the client verifies it (SSL_set1_host probe.test), ping/pong both ways

threads (3.5.9-3): OPENSSL_THREADS in configuration.h (build.sh refuses a build without it, and a Configure that disabled threads); 4 pthreads x 2000 rounds of SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256, RAND_bytes and ERR_raise/ERR_get_error (per-thread queues), CRYPTO_THREAD_write_lock counter and CRYPTO_atomic_add totals exact, CRYPTO_THREAD_run_once + OPENSSL_init_crypto once under contention; both flavours
